summary: Tested partner self-register Country field + clearer submit flow. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (register stores uppercased country, optional for back-compat, 1-char country 422, re-register of invited keeps existing country / fills missing one, join keeps country, submit 422 lists 'document: bank proof' etc., submit 200 once complete). Frontend E2E: /partner/register shows Country select (251 options), HTML-required blocks submit without country, name+email+country -> partner-register-done; DB agent.country=AE. Join -> /partner/me Profile country pre-filled 'United Arab Emirates (AE)'. Docs step shows * + Required badges only on id_proof/address_proof/bank_proof; badge disappears after upload. Agreement step shows amber agent-missing-list with correct items; Go-to buttons (0/1/2) jump to right step; agent-submit disabled while missing or unsigned, enabled after signing, submit -> status submitted + Under review card. All requested features working.

ui_bugs.issue: On a fresh browser session the page hard-reloads ~0.5-2s after load, wiping anything typed on /partner/register (observed repeatedly in Playwright). Pre-existing, not part of this change; likely preview build-version mismatch or SW first install.

integration_issues.flow: Agreement step missing list vs backend
integration_issues.issue: missingItems() reads local form state. Unsaved Profile/Banking edits (user clicks step tab 4 directly without Save) make the list empty and enable Submit, but backend still returns 422 'Still missing: ...'. Consider persisting before submit or computing from server state.

action_items: Optional: in AgentPortal.submit(), call persist(false) (save profile+banking) before agentApi.submit() so unsaved local edits don't trigger a 422
Optional: signed check in AgentPortal uses !!form.agreement?.version; match against current agreement version (as AgentAgreementStep does) so outdated signatures don't enable Submit
Low: look into first-load auto reload wiping form input (versionGuard/SW)
critical_code_review_comments: AgentPortal.jsx L85 signed = !!form.agreement?.version doesn't check version == current AGREEMENT_VERSION; backend does
Register page uses /api/v1/meta/countries while profile uses masters countries; both ISO-2 so pre-fill works
